latest_release.body:
Appwrite 2.7.2 is a security patch for the 2.7 line. It backports the security fixes released on `main` since 2.7.1, rebuilds on `appwrite/base` 2.2.11 to clear the image's open vulnerability findings, and ships with the 1.2.181 self-hosted Console (was 1.2.138). Upgrading from 2.7.1 needs no schema changes; we recommend every 2.7 install upgrades.

### Highlights

- Security fixes across auth, abuse limits, storage, realtime, messaging, functions, VCS and proxy (below).
- Base image `appwrite/base` 2.2.11: patched git, curl, libexpat, perl, rsync and Docker CLI packages, and Go 1.27.4 for `git-remote-entire`.
- Console 1.2.181.

### Fixes

**Abuse limits**

- Rate limits kept per account or per email address are now also kept per project. (#15280)
- Code and secret confirmation routes (verification, recovery, token, phone and magic URL sessions, MFA) now count every caller, including API keys. (#15277, #15470)

**Auth**

- Email verification tokens are claimed under the user row lock. (#15278)
- Organization project transfers require an organization owner. (#15178)

**Storage**

- Buckets with `allowedFileExtensions` check the uploaded content against the allowed formats. (#15458, #15546)

**Realtime**

- Membership events respect membership privacy. (#15176)
- Account events are addressed by the full user ID. (#15308)
- Member sockets end when their project team is deleted. (#15335)

**Messaging**

- Attaching a push notification image requires `files.read`, and its URL is withheld from callers without it. (#15302, #15341)
- A message can only be updated through its own provider type's route. (#15409)

**Functions, sites and deployments**

- Server credentials stay out of client-readable schedules. (#15259)
- Deployment downloads with a key check the read scope. (#15460)
- Password-typed template variables are stored as secrets, and template variables match their code. (#15477, #15414)

**VCS**

- Webhook deployments are pinned to the resolved repository and build only at the branch head the provider reports. (#15261, #15279)
- Entire and Origin installation state is bound to the caller. (#15181)
- Commit preview hostnames are bound to their project and resource. (#15334)

**Proxy, databases, GraphQL and migrations**

- Rule domains are claimed only on a DNS label boundary. (#15303)
- Cached list fields are scoped to the version they were read at. (#15187)
- GraphQL list complexity is charged even when the selection is skipped. (#15305)
- The migration export download link is hidden from keys without data access. (#15268)

### Under the hood

- `appwrite/base` 2.2.11 (#15492, #15531) and patched Debian packages in the Console image (#15491).
- The migration package holds `appwrite/appwrite` (PHP SDK) at 32.2 on 2.7.x (#15534); the abuse package requires `^32.2.0` (#15474).

### Removed

Nothing.

### Install

```bash
docker run -it --rm \
    --volume /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
    --volume "$(pwd)"/appwrite:/usr/src/code/appwrite:rw \
    --entrypoint="install" \
    appwrite/appwrite:2.7.2
```

### Upgrade

Upgrading from 2.7.1 uses the same command with `--entrypoint="upgrade"`, then run the migration. 2.7.2 uses the same migration as 2.7.1, so `migrate` changes no data on an install already on 2.7.1.

```bash
cd appwrite
docker compose exec appwrite migrate
```

**Back up your data first.**

### Contributors

Thank you to everyone who contributed to 2.7.2:

@ChiragAgg5k, @HarshMN2345
